findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant validation in document access checks
findings.body: Returning true unconditionally authorizes document reads even when userTenant and documentTenant differ. This removes the tenant boundary previously enforced by this exported access-control function and permits cross-tenant document access wherever it is used.

findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant ownership check
findings.body: This previously reported defect remains open after current-source revalidation. Evidence: Current src/access.ts still returns true unconditionally, and the full PR diff replaces `userTenant === documentTenant` with `true` at line 2, so cross-tenant reads remain authorized.
